reviews.comment: Prof Loring is great at his job. I'm not sales-oriented so this class was tough for me but he made it tolerable. He is passionate and cares about all his students. There were 3 major roleplays (but he is adding one next semester) that really pushed me out of my comfort zone, but gave me a great look at what a real sales role would look like.
The professor is engaging and helpful. There are lots of small assignments, and they are important to do well on because the role plays are very hard. Difficult class but very helpful.

His grading approach lacks consistency and clarity, and he frequently leans on frameworks such as Clifton Strengths instead of providing direct, outcome-focused feedback or resolving student concerns. Otherwise, he is easy to contact and provided good instruction for the foundations of marketing.

Dr. Loring made the dreaded sales class, so so so enjoyable! He is an excellent professor that is so chill but also does an amazing job at preparing you for the roleplays as well as in your career, even if it is not sales. The roleplays are a little intimidating but as long as you practice and take all of his advice, you will be fine.

If there is one professor I could recommend, it would be Loring. I dreaded taking the sales class, but Loring made it so interesting. The role plays can be stressful, but if you prepare and know the material/ background information you should be fine, go to class the day before role plays as he also tends to walk through helpful info.

Dr. Loring is an overconfident professor who spends the majority of class time bragging about how well-connected he is in the sales world. His inflated ego gets in the way of his teaching and makes it difficult for students to engage with the material. Literally switched majors out of professional selling so I wouldn't have to take him again.

Dr. Loring is such an amazing prof!! He values engagement and effort, and wants every student to succeed. This class has multiple role-plays which are great to practice professional selling and open your eyes to that field. He is so willing to give guidance/feedback, and makes sure each part of the class brings value. I highly recommend him!!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I enjoyed Dr. Loring's survey of marketing class! It was only a two week course but I liked how he set everything up, and he grades SO easy. Our final presentation was a lot for sure, but he gave us ample time to work on it outside of class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall, I have to say Dr. Loring is such a good professor. He cares about his students and while I'm not on the sales track, this class was really useful. The role plays can be stressful but if you prepare and go to class, you'll be fine. The class might be nerve-wracking at first, but it gets better the further you go in the semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I LOVED Loring. Going into this class I was dreading sales and this class, but Loring made this class so fun and interesting and it has been my favorite so far at A&M and Mays. Though there can be a lot of work, all of it has its purpose to help students and be a resource. Attendance isn't mandatory, but it is helpful for prepping for the roleplay
This professor is great! He genuinely cares about his students and loves to help them find their right fit! All of his assignments have practical applications!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The role plays in this class are a major part of your grade, but not too hard. Go to class to help prepare, make sure to practice!! The annoying thing about this class is the quizzes. He doesn't drop any so a few bad ones will ruin your grade. Also work on your SSI score throughout the semester!

I would like to believe that Professor Loring cares about his students. That being said, he is not very empathetic to students' situations. The class is not hard and attendance is not required. But if you are not present in class, you will have no idea what is going on for assignments, specifically for the roleplays.

At first I hated this class, I'm not a sales major and saw no purpose in taking this class, however, Loring does a great job of providing in depth lectures about different sales method and actually gives tangible information about how to sell yourself and your ideas. Although lecture is not necessary, it'll def help your role play grade.

Dr. Loring genuinely cares about his students and is an amazing resource to seek out after class. He will provide great insight to you and your future career and has helped point me in the right direction for my career path. Not to mention and awesome guy who loves to teach. Dr. Loring makes every lecture count and I would 100% recommend taking him

Professor Loring is extremely passionate about sales and what he teaches. He works really hard to understand his students and provide feedback when they need it. His lectures are very engaging and interactive. You wont regret taking his classes because you grow so much and develop important skills through the different projects and activities.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Loring is a great professor! Gives tons of advice for career fairs/jobs and prepares you for the real world. This class is very hands-on and involved but it made me interested in sales when I never would have been if I didn't take his class!

Easily the best professor in my 4 years at A&M. Not only does Dr. Loring have an absolute passion for his job, he truly cares about each and every student that walks in his room. I wish there were words to describe how caring and enthusiastic Dr. L is but if you ever get the chance to take a class from him, don't pass it up!

Professor Loring is a passionate, enthusiastic, and caring professor that wishes to teach you the fundamentals of selling. I enjoyed his class and the important lessons he's taught me. The class isn't hard and the two major roleplays along with quizzes and some other assignments dictate your grade. Show up, pay attention, and you'll be fine.

This professor has been my favorite one so far in college. He challenges you to step out of your comfort zone and is in your corner when you need help. Go to lectures, not note heavy, just pay attention and interact. You get out what you put in!
Professor Loring is AWESOME! Took him during Summer 1 (in-person) and I actually looked forward to going to class everyday. Hes witty and makes class fun. Lets you out early too.

I took this class as a marketing elective but he's one of the best profs I've had for sure. He truly cares about the success of his students and gave really engaging lectures. The class consisted of recording weekly videos, some quizzes, two role-plays, and one final exam but was not bad at all! Definitely take his class if you can.

Loring is by far the best professor and mentor I have had in college. He is so passionate about helping students and is always offering extra ways to network and improve their skills. Use these opportunities and you will see the hard work pay off in and out of class. Only one test, two role plays, and a few other assignments meant to help you!

Professor Loring was easily the best professor I have ever had in college. He was so passionate about helping the students learn and improve! I highly recommend taking any course you can with him, and go chat with him in office hours because he gives great advice and feedback. Overall, a great guy.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Loring was amazing! He is super insightful and helpful when you need it. His class is mandatory but worth it. He gives presentations to do but if you listen to his description/rubric, ask for his help, and use the feedback he gives you, it will be great. Highly recommend!
Great lecturer. Very passionate about marketing. Each lecture consisted of engaging discussions. They made me more interested in the material and made this summer session go by much faster.
Best professor I've ever had truly inspirational

You will grow so much in this class. It pushed me out of my comfort zone and I learned a lot. Loring is passionate about sales. He genuinely wants to help each of his students learn what their career path is. The best prof!

The majority of your grade comes form a two part project/presentation, and two exams. The exam questions come from the textbook, so be sure to read. He gives clear guidelines for the presentation, and gives a lot of feedback. You can tell that he really enjoys teaching this class and interacting with his students.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Loring is a great professor who does not believe exams are what determine how well students learn, instead focuses on a big project that teaches students what they need to know about marketing. Quizzes and Exams are easy and all online. Project is easy, just answer exactly what he wants from the rubric and you'll make an A. Great lectures too.
